name: semantic-accessibility-audit
explain: Structure web documents using semantic landmark regions (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>) and logical heading hierarchies (h1 -> h2). Accessible form controls leverage aria-describedby for inline validation messages.
steps: Define semantic landmark roles and un-skipped heading structures for screen-reader navigation. || Attach accessible label associations and aria-describedby hint relationships to form inputs.
expect: Valid HTML5 document with accessible landmarks, labels, and error message bindings.

name: async-flow-react-render
explain: Coordinate asynchronous data fetching using Promise.allSettled to enable resilient partial rendering when optional third-party microservices fail.
steps: Dispatch independent metric and recommendation promises concurrently using Promise.allSettled. || Handle rejected promises gracefully in state rather than crashing the primary dashboard.

name: token-storage-security-ux
explain: Analyze token storage security boundaries. Storing bearer tokens in localStorage exposes them to XSS exfiltration; storing session tokens in HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookies protects them from JavaScript access.
steps: Demonstrate that scripts running in the page origin can read tokens from localStorage. || Verify that HttpOnly cookies remain completely inaccessible to document scripts, eliminating token theft via XSS.
expect: Token security boundary verified: localStorage_readable_by_js=true (vulnerable), httpOnly_cookie_readable_by_js=false (safe)

name: accessible-button-vs-div
explain: Compare native semantic <button> and <label> elements against clickable <div> elements. Native buttons automatically provide keyboard Tab focus, Enter/Space activation, and accessibility tree roles.
steps: Implement native button with implicit keyboard focus, Enter/Space activation, and screen-reader role. || Highlight maintenance overhead and keyboard listeners required to make custom divs accessible.
expect: Native button provides built-in keyboard navigation and label target expansion.

name: responsive-layout-flow
explain: Design responsive CSS Grid layouts that maintain consistent DOM reading order. Uses minmax() and overflow-wrap to prevent horizontal viewport clipping at 200% zoom.
steps: Create responsive CSS Grid layout that preserves logical DOM order without CSS order reversals. || Apply overflow-wrap: break-word to prevent long hashes and URLs from overflowing mobile viewports.
expect: Responsive CSS Grid layout adapting to viewport width while preserving tab order.

name: event-loop-microtasks
explain: Demonstrate the browser event loop phases: Call Stack -> Microtasks (Promise.then, queueMicrotask) -> Macrotasks (setTimeout) -> Render Phase. Explains why long synchronous tasks freeze UI rendering.
steps: Enqueue synchronous operations, microtasks, and macrotasks to observe exact execution order. || Verify that the microtask queue drains completely before the browser executes the next macrotask.
expect: Event loop order verified: 5 tasks executed in order

name: react-state-stale-closures
explain: Demonstrate React render state snapshots and stale closures. Calling setCount(count + 1) multiple times captures stale state; functional updates (setCount(prev => prev + 1)) accumulate accurately.
steps: Demonstrate state overwriting when multiple direct updates capture the same render snapshot. || Use functional updater callbacks to receive fresh committed state across batched updates.
expect: React state update verified: direct_stale=1, functional_accumulated=2

name: react-effect-cleanup-abort
explain: Implement React useEffect cleanup functions using AbortController. Aborting in-flight fetch requests upon dependency change prevents race conditions and memory leaks.
steps: Trigger rapid navigation between user IDs to simulate concurrent in-flight HTTP requests. || Abort previous request via controller.abort() in the Effect cleanup function, preventing stale data from overwriting active state.

name: typescript-discriminated-unions
explain: Narrow untrusted API JSON payloads into TypeScript discriminated unions using runtime schema validation. Validates required tags, array types, and error states at the boundary.
steps: Define discriminated union variants with literal status tags ('success', 'rate_limited', 'error'). || Execute runtime validation to catch malformed payloads before constructing the trusted UI state.
expect: TypeScript runtime union verified: valid_status=success, malformed_caught=error

name: react-query-generational-tokens
explain: Use generational query tokens to enforce session isolation in frontend state. When users switch or log out, in-flight callbacks from the previous session are rejected.
steps: Increment generational counter on user authentication and route transitions. || Discard delayed HTTP responses whose generation token does not match the active session.

name: safe-model-text-rendering
explain: Prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) when rendering untrusted LLM outputs. HTML entity escaping converts executable script tags and error handlers into safe text nodes.
steps: Demonstrate XSS vulnerability when inserting untrusted model output via dangerouslySetInnerHTML. || Escape HTML delimiters (&, <, >, ", ') to render content safely without executable tag injection.
expect: Model text rendering verified: unescaped_tag_present=false, safe_entity_present=true
